_how_to: Promos shown at the top of each venue page (where the WiFi lands). Add, edit or remove entries, then run ./deploy.sh. Fields: kicker (small label), title, text, cta (button text), url (button link), image (file in site/assets/img/), until (optional YYYY-MM-DD: hidden after this date), feature (true = big card).

the-bluebell.text: Roast beef 275K, roast chicken 200K or nut roast 150K (++), with Yorkshire pudding and all the trimmings. Pets welcome.

the-bluebell.title: Live sport
the-bluebell.text: Premier League, UFC, F1, rugby, AFL and more, live on Jakarta time when games fall within our opening hours. The timetable is in our Instagram highlights, or ask us to put your game on.

the-bluebell.title: Happy hour
the-bluebell.text: Gin and tonic 100K++ (Classic or Sour Popsicle). Heineken bucket 280K++: buy 4, get 1 free.

the-bluebell.title: Pub Quiz
the-bluebell.text: Teams, rounds and bragging rights at the pub. Grab a pitcher, bring your smartest friends and come for the drinks, stay for a friendly competition.
